snip.t: About kangaroo mother care, which statement is true? (1 mark)
snip.s: Mount Kenya University Paediatrics MCQ Bank

snip.t: Maternal and newborn care: antenatal care, skilled attendance at birth, essential newborn care (warmth, early breastfeeding, cord care), kangaroo mother care and care of sick newborns, prevention of mother-to-child transmission of HIV, and family planning with birth spacing.
snip.s: Paediatrics end of fourth year main exam: 1 July 2019, Paper One, 99 of 100 MCQs

snip.t: A multistakeholder group of newborn health advocates proposed accelerating global kangaroo mother care (KMC) as the standard of care for preterm infants.
Scaling up high-impact maternal and newborn interventions (skilled birth attendance, antenatal care, kangaroo mother care).
snip.s: Junior Clerkship in Paediatrics and Child Health Exam 2019
